remarks: Welcome to Silvermine - the lovely, picturesque section of Norwalk on the New Canaan line. This lovely colonial is located in a quiet setting on a private cul-de-sac. The house features 3570sf of living space which features an open floor plan for the living room and kitchen that leads to a spacious rear deck; dining room and family room, 4 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, upstairs laundry with shelving for convenience. Additional living space in the walk-up attic. Partially finished basement with walk out to rear yard. You want to come see this. Silvermine is convenient to several local shopping centers, Rte 7, the Merritt and Rte 95, as well as wonderful attractions including the Silvermine Golf Club, the Silvermine Art Center, Tavern at GrayBarns.
